title: Durability, Failure, Defense & Recovery Infrastructure
objective: Implement building/infrastructure condition, damage and upkeep bindings; wear/failure/fire/contamination/disaster Event adapters; repair/retrofit/salvage/decommission owner-operation requests; defensive/security/emergency capability projections; Combat/SCL/Hazard integration without duplicate adjudication; governed evacuation/shelter/fire-suppression/quarantine capability references; and MERA dependency/failure/repair adapters with recovery receipts.
acceptance: Building/infrastructure condition and damage remain owner-backed references rather than an MBES damage ledger.
Wear, failure, fire, contamination and disaster observations route as typed Events without duplicate Hazard/Combat adjudication.
Repair, retrofit, salvage and decommission remain owner-operation requests until canonical owners commit them.
Defense, fortification, security and emergency behavior derive only from explicit accepted capability definitions.
Evacuation, shelter, fire-suppression, quarantine and related emergency actions are governed capabilities, not universal automatic outcomes.
MERA dependency/failure/repair evidence composes through adapters without creating a second engineering graph.
Recovery receipts preserve owner history/version/provenance and fail closed on stale or conflicting evidence.
Blocking workflows remain semantic/nonvisual, keyboard-capable and provider-off.
boundaries: Combat, SCL, Hazard, Action/Event and target owners retain canonical adjudication/execution authority.
MIB-12/D17/Inventory retain repair/transformation/resource truth and transactions.
MBES-18 creates no damage, hazard, combat, security, engineering, resource or provenance ledger.
MBES-20 and later MBES tranches remain unauthorized until canonical MBES-18 closeout.
next_action: MBES-18 is completed_verified. MBES-20 — Settlement, Transport & Regional Development Integration — is selected_not_started and requires a later owner Continue for governed start.
